adversarial_test_results.prompt: Of course we should leave early tomorrow to avoid traffic.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: As the clock struck midnight the guests finally went home.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Temporal As opens the sentence before any head noun or verb, so with nothing already read to attach to it should not peak.
